description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractSignalMapper' which serves as a base class for mapping signals to adaptables. It provides extension points for validation, payload enhancement, and header customization, and includes an abstract method for generating specific topic paths based on signals.

classes.name: AbstractSignalMapper
classes.description: An abstract base class for mapping signals to adaptables, providing extension points for validation, payload enhancement, and header customization.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a signal and channel into an Adaptable object, applying optional validation and enhancements.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Abstract method meant to be implemented by subclasses to generate the correct TopicPath based on the signal and channel.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Optional validation of the signal, can be overridden to enforce constraints.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Extension point for customizing the payload builder before building the payload.

methods.name: enhanceHeaders
methods.description: Extension point for customizing the headers of the Adaptable.
